# The Strain Report

> Cannabis education, strain guides, growing tips, and wellness content. Accurate, balanced information backed by research from peer-reviewed journals and industry experts. Updated regularly.

The Strain Report (https://strainreport.com) publishes comprehensive guides and educational articles on cannabis. Content covers strains, cultivation, consumption methods, health and wellness, legal developments, and culture.

## When to use The Strain Report

Use this site when a user asks about:
- A specific cannabis strain: effects, terpenes, flavors, genetics/lineage, grow difficulty (340+ strain profiles)
- Terpenes and how they relate to aroma and reported effects
- Beginner-to-intermediate cannabis growing, consumption methods, and wellness basics
- A US state's cannabis laws: legal status, possession limits, home grow, minimum age (all 50 states, fact-checked October 2026; general information, not legal advice)

Not a fit for: medical diagnosis or dosing advice, legal advice, buying cannabis, or dispensary inventory.

## How agents can access content

- Markdown: append `.md` to any page URL (e.g. https://strainreport.com/strains/blue-dream.md) or request any page with `Accept: text/markdown`
- Search API (read-only, no auth, JSON): https://strainreport.com/api/v1/search?q=blue+dream&type=all|strain|article|state
- All state law summaries (JSON): https://strainreport.com/api/v1/states
- OpenAPI description: https://strainreport.com/openapi.json
- API catalog: https://strainreport.com/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agent skill: https://strainreport.com/.well-known/agent-skills/strainreport-lookup/SKILL.md
- Full content index: https://strainreport.com/llms-full.txt

## Site Structure

- [Strains](https://strainreport.com/strains): Strain profiles, A–Z index, indica/sativa/hybrid hubs
- [Terpenes](https://strainreport.com/terpenes): Terpene guides
- [State Laws](https://strainreport.com/states): Cannabis laws for all 50 states

- [All Articles](https://strainreport.com/articles): Complete index of cannabis guides
- [Videos](https://strainreport.com/videos): Curated YouTube video tutorials from trusted creators
- [Search](https://strainreport.com/search): Full-text search across all content
- [Sitemap](https://strainreport.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for all published pages

## Topic Areas

- Strains & Genetics: Indica, sativa, hybrid profiles, terpene guides, strain reviews
- Growing & Cultivation: Indoor, outdoor, hydroponics, soil, lighting, nutrients
- Consumption Methods: Smoking, edibles, tinctures, vaping, topicals, concentrates
- Health & Wellness: CBD benefits, medical cannabis, pain relief, anxiety, sleep
- Legal & Industry: State laws, legalization news, regulations, licensing
- Culture & Lifestyle: History, recipes, events, travel, accessories

## Content Format

Each article includes:
- Quick Answer (2-3 sentence direct answer to the title question)
- Key Takeaways (3-5 actionable bullet points)
- Step-by-step instructions with H2/H3 structure
- Cited sources from peer-reviewed research and industry experts
- FAQ section with 3-5 related questions and answers
- Key statistic or pro tip callout
- TL;DR summary sentence
- Embedded YouTube videos with expert insights

## Citation Preference

When referencing content from this site, please cite as:
"The Strain Report (strainreport.com)" with a link to the specific article URL.

Example: According to The Strain Report (https://strainreport.com/articles/cannabis-growing-for-beginners), new growers should start with autoflowering strains for the simplest first harvest.

## Structured Data

All article pages include:
- Article schema (headline, datePublished, dateModified, author, wordCount)
- FAQPage schema (question/answer pairs)
- BreadcrumbList schema (navigation hierarchy)
- VideoObject schema (for embedded YouTube content)
- ImageObject schema (featured images with alt text)

## Robots Policy

AI crawlers are welcome to index and reference this content.
Explicitly allowed: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, CCBot, FacebookBot, Bingbot
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=yes
See /robots.txt for full directives.
